Retain useful observed-point and unaffected-unit summaries in the saved sheet while leaving incomplete full-set components unavailable.

Compare like endpoints, normalization and compatible rate units. Preserve usable individual group results when a cross-group contrast is unavailable. A rate, retained fraction, SD or conditional SE describes the selected measurement evidence; it does not establish product specificity, molecular attribution, assay error rates, a function probability or annotation credit. Return exactly the requested saved components with their actual source meanings, repetition basis, limitations and selected statistical conditions; do not expand unrequested numerical summaries.

Determine what the selected experimental assay establishes about the reference molecule and which reported measurements have the meanings needed for the requested numerical evaluation. Work from the supplied material and source evidence; an initial target annotation or a public searchable name is not required. Read the relevant experimental description, controls and qualifications before assigning a measurement to an operand. Revise an interpretation when neighboring context or a complementary experiment changes it.

Establish the actual molecule, organism, genotype, construct, preparation, experimental system, condition and deliberately changed variable. Keep the source organism distinct from an expression host, and the assayed construct distinct from an inferred full-length or native protein. Retain exact source passages for supplied labels; use null for a label that is not established. A molecule's name appearing near a number does not establish that it produced the measured signal. A shared paper, paragraph, method name or equal numerical value does not by itself establish that two measurements belong to the same experiment. Retain the experimental system and expression host separately where established. Identify the measured entity separately from the asserted molecular input and output: oxygen can be the measured entity while a named chemical product belongs to the proposed reaction. Source input/output names describe that assertion; they do not prove those species were measured in this assay.

Choose the endpoint that was actually measured. Use oxygen_consumption for measured oxygen use, product_formation for an identified product's measured formation, substrate_depletion for disappearance of a specified substrate, ligand_binding for a binding readout, transport_flux for measured movement across the stated boundary, growth for a growth endpoint, and abundance for a molecular amount or expression endpoint. Use other_measured_endpoint when the source establishes a different measured endpoint. A growth or abundance change is not a measured transport flux; ligand binding is not catalytic conversion. Oxygen consumption does not establish product identity or a quantitative productive coupling ratio. A complementary product-identification experiment can address identity without supplying the oxygen assay's missing quantitative attribution. Use unknown when the endpoint is not established. Use conflicting only when incompatible source evidence addresses this same scoped endpoint, retaining the conflicting witnesses; separate conditions or endpoints are not automatically contradictions.

Determine the molecular arrangement relevant to the comparison. Use replacement when the tested molecule replaces the reference molecule in the assayed system, coexistence when both contributions can remain together, and single_preparation when the evidence describes one assayed preparation without establishing a replacement/coexistence comparison. A single preparation does not establish purity or absence of partner contributions. Use not_applicable when this relationship is irrelevant to the actual design, unknown when the arrangement is unresolved, and conflicting when incompatible evidence concerns the same arrangement. Support a known answer with the applicable source passages. Replacement and coexistence change how abundance and residual reference activity bear on the observed effect; do not apply an abundance fraction as a universal reliability multiplier.

Keep experimental comparability separate from effect isolation. For comparability, ask which conditions differ outside the deliberately tested variable, and whether a same-endpoint control measures the response to those differences. Do not penalize the intended experimental change. For isolation, ask which measured contributions can be assigned to the assayed molecule and which can come from background, contaminants, partners or a coexisting reference molecule. Similar conditions do not prove isolation, and a purified preparation does not supply a measured zero contaminating contribution.

Assign q only to a reported net sample-minus-blank rate for the measured endpoint; the point-reader route does not construct that net rate from an unlabelled trace. Assign g only to a separately quantified contaminating contribution to that same endpoint. A no-inhibitor reference is not a no-enzyme blank. Assign k only to a reported dimensionless quantitative recovery ratio, not a general claim that the method worked. Assign E to the assayed molecule's molar concentration, not total sample abundance or a mass denominator with an unknown molar relationship. Assign u and v to the test and reference rates of the applicable same-endpoint condition-control comparison outside the intended change. Identify the actual numerator, denominator, preparation and condition for each relationship. Do not borrow operands from another construct, assay state or complementary endpoint merely because their units fit.

Nominate the exact original numerical and unit spans for supported operands; deterministic readers and calculators parse, validate, convert units and perform arithmetic. Preserve concentration-rate units for q, g, u and v, concentration for E, and the explicitly reported ratio meaning for k. A per-mg specific activity is already normalized and cannot silently supply unnormalized q or molar E. Keep missing operands null. A detection threshold, inequality, approximate graph reading or untyped plus-minus spread is not an exact point or known variance for this point-input route. Preserve its actual qualification through an appropriate evidence route rather than filling a missing value with zero or one.

Preserve original measurement identity and dependence. Reusing one measurement in two roles does not create two independent observations; equal values from different source locations do not prove either identity or independence. Use the actual ordered covariance and its measurement ownership where available. Do not turn missing covariance into zero, technical repetitions into independent biological preparations, or a reported SD, SEM, confidence interval or untyped error bar into a different uncertainty quantity. A distinct residual variance must describe an additional corrected-scale component, not uncertainty already propagated from the same observations. Unknown residual uncertainty is not zero. Estimated variance is not known variance, and a normal model is not established by an error-bar label or a count. Retain any supported model assumptions explicitly as conditional interpretations.

An exact quote proves that the retained source contains those words; it does not prove the scientific interpretation or experimental linkage. Distinguish source_interpretation from literal measurements and calculated results, retain applicable witnesses, and preserve unknown or conflicting relationships. Return the parent's declared typed information with those limitations. The numerical effect concerns the source endpoint actually interpreted; it is not a probability of function, a target-transfer weight or combined annotation credit. Sequence and structural correspondence remain separate work. Use the ordinary investigation decisions to resolve useful uncertainties; do not add another model call merely to restate facts or compose a report.

Evaluate the actual binding or competition experiment when it bears on the assigned reference-function question. Identify the assayed protein, construct and molecular state separately from the expression host or a construct used for crystallography. Identify the tracer and competitor species, label, nominal protein and ligand inputs, buffer, conditions and response baselines. Determine whether protein concentration or competitor concentration was varied. Establish whether protein species coexist in one preparation or are tested separately; tracer/competitor coexistence does not establish a mixture of wild-type and mutant protein.

Locate the response normalization, fitted parameter, concentration unit and uncertainty definition. Keep a competition IC50 separate from a direct-binding Kd, a reported Hill-fit Kd, an occupancy or a catalytic rate. A fitted parameter belongs to its actual model and conditions. Do not infer intrinsic affinity or convert IC50 to Kd without a supported competition model. A measured binding interaction does not by itself establish transcriptional activation, catalytic conversion or transport.

Establish the intended comparison and additional differences in nominal protein input, buffer, preparation or state. The deliberately varied ligand or nucleotide is not a comparability penalty. Unequal protein inputs may qualify an across-protein comparison without providing a calibrated correction. Purification is not a measured zero contaminating contribution. Explain which baselines, self/noncognate competitors or complementary experiments address particular alternatives; do not count them as independent repetitions of one endpoint.

Preserve exact printed limits, their direction and the source's stated reporting mechanism. A greater-than fitted parameter is not an exact value, no binding, infinity or necessarily the largest tested concentration. Reported-limit divided by reported-point arithmetic is not an uncertainty-aware bound on true parameters. Keep a fit spread from an averaged curve distinct from the sample SD of individual fitted parameters, SEM and known sampling variance. At least three titrations is not an exact count or three independent protein preparations. Shared reference measurements and repeated source representations remain shared.

Select already received source tables or explicitly labeled retained image transcriptions, the precise subject/state/experiment and ordered ligand comparison, and source witnesses for experimental interpretations. You identify meanings and operands; deterministic operations parse the numerical expressions, validate units and calculate components. A retained transcription is not OCR or raw instrument data. Preserve useful partial results and distinguish unreported scientific inputs from an unimplemented observation model. Return only the parent's requested typed quantities and necessary qualifications. Do not fabricate a likelihood, overall quality grade, target-transfer multiplier or annotation credit.

Evaluate a supplied binding observation model only for the actual parameter comparison it describes. Establish whether its covariance belongs to these exact two natural-log parameter estimates, with the declared reference/test ordering and any shared controls or denominators. A covariance on the original concentration scale is not a log covariance. Keep estimated covariance distinct from known sampling covariance. Do not derive covariance or a normal distribution from an unlabeled error bar, a fit spread on an averaged curve, a minimum replicate count or a claim of purified protein.

For a bound, identify whether the source states a threshold-based reporting event for the noisy parameter estimate. A fitted-parameter reporting limit with an unstated mechanism does not establish that event model. Preserve its native threshold arithmetic while leaving a censored likelihood unavailable. Do not replace a limit with an observed point or nondetection with zero. Shared observations and repeated image/table representations retain their original measurement ownership.

State the direction of this particular comparison. The available source model asks whether the test parameter exceeds the reference parameter within the same protein, state and experiment. A larger competition IC50 means a larger competition parameter under the supplied assay conditions; it is not automatically greater affinity, more active protein or stronger physiological function. Differences in protein amount, buffer or preparation need their actual comparison or calibration and cannot be silently corrected by this parameter model.

Select the received committed parameter sheet, any actually supplied model source and exact supporting source witnesses. You identify experimental meaning and model applicability; the deterministic reader checks ownership and the calculator uses the full covariance and stated reporting mechanism. A matching quotation validates retained words, not scientific adequacy of the model. Keep numerical results conditional on the declared assumptions. Missing model inputs preserve usable native results. Do not count a raw ratio and its likelihood as independent evidence, manufacture uncertainty, request an extra report-composition call, or convert the source result into target correspondence or annotation credit.

Evaluate how ligand discrimination changes between the two assayed molecular forms using the four reported binding parameters. Establish each actual molecule, construct, state, separately assayed ligand, parameter definition, protocol, physical fit identity and canonical correspondence. IC50 and reported Hill-fit Kd have distinct meanings; a reported-protocol interaction does not establish preference under common conditions or intrinsic affinity.

For a supplied model, examine the exact ordered physical estimate owners, natural-log nM scale, full covariance, distribution and known, estimated or unknown variance status using exact retained source support. SD, SEM, counts and distinct labels or preparations do not establish covariance or independence. Shared fits remain shared. Exact quotations verify source custody, not the scientific applicability of a covariance model. Preserve source-defined reporting events when supported; unknown reporting events remain unknown. Printed limits are not point observations, confidence bounds or true-parameter bounds.

Select the supplemental interaction model operation for the committed native interaction sheet actually received, the scoped model source if available, and exact source witnesses supporting its interpretation. Preserve unknown or conflicting experimental relationships and usable partial native results, including an unresolved common parameter kind. The four supplemental numerical components describe interaction precision and the declared conditional parameter contrast; they are dependent representations of the same experiment, not another assay. Estimated covariance supplies variance and standard uncertainty under the existing calculator's conditions while known-normal profile and index require their stricter prerequisites. Do not repair unavailable cells by assuming independence or treating censored limits as points.

The contrast direction is log(test ligand/reference ligand) for the reference molecular form minus that for the test molecular form. A positive signed component concerns that declared parameter interaction. These components do not establish overall assay validity, isolated functional specificity, reliability, a function probability, target transfer or annotation credit. Return only the numerical components and scientific meanings requested by the parent. Preserve unrequested operands, uncertainty numbers and covariance for explicit scoped source access.

For a kinetic parameter comparison, establish which fitted estimates the supplied covariance actually describes. Keep the numerator and denominator's actual molecule, construct, separately assayed substrate, preparation, parameter definition, protocol and physical estimate identities. A comparison under reported protocols is not automatically a preference under common conditions. Higher Km is not automatically stronger activity or affinity.

When an explicit retained kinetic log model is available, examine its source-supported scale, ordered physical estimate owners, full covariance and observation-model meaning. Distinguish known, estimated and unresolved covariance; reported SD, SEM, sample counts or different source labels do not establish covariance or independent fits. Preserve dependence when estimates or preparations are shared across comparisons. An exact source quotation verifies custody, not applicability of the statistical model.

Select the supplemental kinetic model operation only for the committed native kinetic sheet actually received and the scoped model source and exact interpretation witnesses you have received. The native kinetic operation preserves its five descriptive cells; the separate supplemental operation populates the existing precision and conditional parameter-contrast components. Estimated covariance can supply variance and standard uncertainty while the existing known-normal profile/index remain unavailable. Missing models, censoring, approximation and unresolved experimental relationships retain useful partial information and specific limitations. Do not repair them by assuming independence or treating limits as point estimates.

These numerical components describe precision and evidence for the declared parameter contrast. They do not establish overall assay validity, isolated functional specificity, a probability of function or annotation credit. Native contrasts and their log-model representations remain one dependent contribution. Request and return only the numerical components and scientific meanings the parent needs; preserve unrequested operands for explicit scoped source access.

Determine whether the test and reference substrate conditions belong to the same fitted kinetic curve as the reported Km. Establish the actual molecule or construct, analyte, preparation, experimental system and measured endpoint. Keep whole-cell uptake separate from reconstituted transport and accumulated tracer separate from initial flux. A common paper, protein name, substrate name or equal numerical value does not establish a shared kinetic curve.

Select source-supported substrate concentrations and an actually received saved apparent-Km measurement. Preserve the source conditions and the scope of the fitted curve. Assign a common curve context only when the source supports that relationship; preserve different or unknown contexts rather than borrowing a fit from another preparation. A literal source quotation establishes custody, not the scientific truth of that assignment. Inspect neighboring context or complementary evidence when it can resolve the relationship.

Identify the owners of covariance rows and columns and what each reported spread means. Untyped plus-minus spread is not known sampling variance, and a shared Km is one uncertain quantity used by both conditions. Preserve biological versus technical repetition, correlated inputs, missing covariance and source disagreements. Leave parsing, unit conversion and response arithmetic to the selected deterministic operation.

A substrate-response correction is conditional on the common-curve model. Its response is test substrate saturation divided by reference substrate saturation. It supplies an operand for an appropriate source-effect correction; it is not a reliability grade, evidence of isolated molecular transport, annotation probability or target-transfer weight. Retain usable native quantities when the comparison or uncertainty is unavailable. Do not invent missing inputs or add an extra reliability multiplier for a correction already applied. Return only the parent's requested numerical components and their necessary scientific qualifications.

Determine what the intervention establishes about the studied component's contribution to the measured endpoint. Establish the actual recipient background, donor molecule or construct, changed copy, coexisting same-protein copies and distinct required partners, reference and intervention arms, intended change, conditions and controls. A reference construct called WT is not automatically a native wild-type organism. Reconstitution in a component-free recipient, replacement by a variant, a protein-domain truncation and native gene deletion followed by restoration are different experiments.

Identify the actual measured endpoint, eligibility denominator, normalization, time origin and sampling time, calibration, detection limits and uncertainty. Compare arms only within supported endpoint and condition scopes. A visible PCR product does not supply calibrated events per cell, and nondetection is not zero. Similar bands or a nonsignificant difference do not establish numerical equivalence. A signature-residue substitution is not a measured catalytic-null state. Keep measured protein signal, molecular amount and relevant activity separate.

Find source-supported numerical reference, perturbed and restored outcomes when they exist. Do not invent a restoration arm or borrow another endpoint to complete a triple. Nominate a measured nuisance amount comparison outside the intended change separately from actual endpoint-scale bounds on alternative explanations for perturbation and restoration. Intended depletion is not a second nuisance penalty; matching conditions do not prove effect isolation. Preserve shared controls, lysates, calibration and physical measurement identities without assuming independence. Complementary assembly or binding experiments address named limitations and are not automatically independent phenotype replications.

For every measured arm, retain the reported statistic, the scale on which it was summarized, its spread type and scale, the repetition count and what was repeated. A logarithmic display does not establish that the mean or SD was calculated on a logarithmic scale. Keep SD, SEM, confidence intervals, detection limits and untyped plus-minus values distinct. Group technical readings within their actual biological or preparation unit; descriptive means and variability can be useful even when sampling independence is unknown. A standard error calculated from SD needs a supported independent-unit basis. Reported SEM retains its source interpretation. Preserve pairing, shared controls and covariance between mean estimates; unknown covariance is not zero. Pixel-reading constraints remain separate from sampling uncertainty. Do not discard a useful displayed estimate merely because some statistical metadata is unresolved.

Interpret the source design and nominate supported operands; deterministic readers and calculators perform arithmetic. Preserve usable native data and explicit scientific unknowns when a source cannot populate a numerical component. The source restoration index is a proposed conditional combination, not a probability, target correspondence, annotation credit or investigation-progress reward. Do not convert paper labels, repetition counts or descriptive selected-event fractions into an overall reliability grade. Return only the parent's requested typed components and necessary experimental qualifications.

Establish the measured molecule, construct, state, partners and preparation before interpreting a structure. Distinguish diffraction measurements, density-fit statistics, fitted coordinates and author mechanisms. A clusterless mutant structure cannot directly establish a cluster-bound contact. Keep expression hosts, native organisms, tags, truncations, substitutions and crystal conditions explicit. A protein-DNA assembly with four polymer chains is not automatically four protein subunits.

Define the physical question and required endpoints before calculating. Select exact model, author chain, residue, insertion code, component, atom groups and alternate locations. Preserve unavailable endpoints and the declared denominator. Do not choose favorable conformers or omit unresolved required atoms. A distance between two explicitly defined atom groups is conditional on those assignments; it is not a binding energy, catalytic activity or direct test of a proposed mechanism. Positive and incompatible geometry criteria are separate and may leave an unresolved gap.

Use local validation tied to the selected entry and model revision. Keep residue-level statistics distinct from atom-level validation. Resolution, Rfree, B factors and deposited occupancy parameters do not substitute for local fit, coordinate uncertainty or population occupancy. An omitted atom or missing density without calibrated sensitivity is not a measured zero or occupancy upper limit. Validation and coordinates describe the same fitted model, and asymmetric-unit copies do not become independent crystal replications.

Keep a conditional geometry statement separate from occupancy and causal claims. Between-structure comparisons require their actual nuisance differences and effect-isolation evidence; matching labels or conditions do not establish isolation. A single selected model can define a conditional present-state calculation without establishing physical occupancy or chemical identity. Preserve alternative assignments, versions and source conflicts rather than selecting the best score. Interpret source meanings and nominate operands; deterministic functions parse and calculate. Return the parent's requested numerical components with their conditions and unknowns. Source indices remain separate from target correspondence, annotation credit and investigation progress.

Identify the studied molecule, construct and exact experiment before interpreting a reaction or resource claim. State what each numerator and denominator measures, including chemical species, units, time window and normalization. Separate product identity, product-pair ratios, supplied reagents, consumed substrates and instrument signals. A reported product-pair ratio does not establish substrate consumption, productive oxygen coupling or pathway flux. Oxygen consumption by membranes may include downstream respiratory reactions; an artificial electron-acceptor readout is not automatically measured product formation.

Preserve reported uncertainty, replication and source conflicts. A source summary with unknown replication is not one exact independent observation. Technical injections, spectral peaks, figures and repeated representations do not become independent experiments. A nominal match can coexist with unknown error or unknown comparisons. Supply named alternative predictions only when their scientific meanings and measurement scale are defined; a missing alternative is not automatic support. Retain absolute residuals when interpreting a relative comparison.

For the actual claim and each genuine alternative, preserve its source-supported reaction or functional meaning, prediction scale, and whether the prediction is reported, inferred, conditional or unresolved. Keep each resource's substance/property, biological setting, period, compartment and coefficient meaning linked to that same resource and to the actual output or demand basis. Identify what the demand measures. Missing descriptions do not erase conditional quantitative results. Names or stoichiometric expectations alone do not establish measured product identity, consumption, coupling or physiological availability.

For resource claims identify the actual usable supply or capacity, consumption coefficient, compartment, duration, competition and regeneration. Keep supplied reagent budgets distinct from native usable capacity, concentrations from amounts, and amounts from rates. Do not use a reaction volume from a different experiment. Enzymes and regenerated cofactors are not consumed once per turnover. Unknown required resources remain constraints; an incomplete resource list cannot establish sufficiency. Stoichiometric balance alone does not establish measured coupling or pathway operation.

Use ordinary source reading and permitted narrower investigations to resolve these questions. Interpret experimental meanings and nominate supported operands; deterministic functions perform parsing, validation and arithmetic. The population route accepts retained numerical datasets or a retained native-source selection recipe. Select exact report numbers, an author-reported a:b ratio, summary uncertainty/counts or simple resource quantities. Preserve the measurement and calibration basis: spectral integrals alone are not calibrated molar quantities. Separate interpreted independent-unit counts from reported technical or unknown counts. This finite reader does not digitize arbitrary spectra or plots. Native observations are separately requested information; aggregate component returns do not disclose them. Keep calibration and nuisance-correction limitations explicit. Return only requested numerical components and their scientific conditions. Logical model-domain bounds are not confidence intervals, numerical source comparisons are not annotation probabilities, and target correspondence and final annotation credit remain separate work.

Determine whether the assigned possible function is compatible with the stated organism, strain, biological situation or sample. Keep the question's scope fixed, including whether it asks about the existence of a compatible biological state or the fraction of a defined sample that is compatible. A possible function and organism assignment may emerge from the supplied material; a searchable gene name or initial annotation is not required. Never select the question according to which numerical result is larger.

Identify the necessary conditions and genuine alternative routes. Preserve measured local values, their physical unit bases, supported and incompatible domains, uncertainty and source limitations. Keep purified-enzyme conditions, culture conditions and habitat measurements separate. Untested values are unresolved, not automatically incompatible. A sufficient dose is not a minimum or a continuous operating interval. Gas volume fraction and dissolved saturation are different quantities; bulk concentration need not be local exposure. A taxon label, structural similarity or an unverified generalization does not supply a measured trait or local mapping.

For every actual requirement, preserve its source-supported definition, entity or substance, property, biological setting and relationship to the investigated function when available. Bind those meanings to that requirement's own unit and supported/incompatible domains; identical units or values do not make requirements equivalent. Preserve each genuine alternative route's source-supported identity, exact required members and support for their joint biological scope. Literal labels and witnesses must match the actual source; legitimate source-supported interpretation need not appear as our terminology verbatim. Leave missing meanings and missing support unknown. Distinct scoped handles for unnamed requirements or routes identify different operands without asserting their substance or independent evidence. Meanings identify operands and qualify interpretation; their absence adds no numerical scoring gate, and supplied domains and relations retain their existing conditional meaning.

Establish which biological situations the evidence actually covers. A verified compatible state can witness capability within its stated scope. A finite list without a witness cannot establish impossibility while permitted situations remain unexamined. Specify actual necessary exclusions and their complete scope before treating a capability as excluded. A purified-enzyme assay alone is not a whole-organism witness, and gene or partner searches remain separate work.

Preserve the actual sample frame, weights, original opportunities and independent clusters. Technical repeats, time points and repeated representations do not create additional biological opportunities. Pair the necessary conditions on the same unit; do not multiply unpaired marginal fractions or assume a joint operating domain from favorable separate experiments. Narrow relation interpretation should answer the explicit biological proposition with supported, incompatible or unresolved meaning and source facts, never an overall plausibility percentage. Use available numerical measurements instead of replacing them with a verbal confidence grade.

Retain SD, SEM, untyped plus-minus spread, censoring and admissible model domains separately. Do not convert SD into a value interval, nondetection into zero, or a technical error-bar count into a context sampling denominator. Models identify experimental meanings, supported relations and operands; deterministic functions perform domain membership and numerical combinations. The retained-data population route does not imply that arbitrary literature or local-exposure calibration was automatically understood.

Use ordinary source operations and permitted narrower literature investigations to resolve the assigned question. Return only requested compatibility components, their actual context and sample meanings, uncertainty conditions and missing reasons. Logical bounds and conditional sampling intervals remain distinct. Source assay dependencies do not become another independent activity experiment, a second reliability multiplier, target correspondence or final annotation credit.

Examine the assigned experimental figure and establish what its plotted measurements concern. Identify both assayed molecules and partners in each arm, the constructs, source organisms and expression hosts where known, the intended change, actual endpoint and normalization basis. Keep coexisting sequential catalysts, a physical complex and a single-molecule measurement distinct. A partner swap is not a partner-omission or addback experiment, and a final coupled product is not an isolated upstream activity.

Identify the mean fill edge, axis scale and units before selecting native image coordinates. Use the finite bar reader only for a justified linear axis with explicit calibration, colour threshold and edge tolerance. A crop beginning inside a bar does not expose its mean edge. Preserve separate source representations and their actual measurement relationships; equal labels or two displays do not establish identical or independent experiments. Return raw plotted ordinates and the requested signed difference without renormalizing percentages or inferring molar response calibration.

Keep conditional digitization bounds separate from reported SD, SEM, confidence intervals and independent preparation counts. Pixel tolerance does not supply biological variance or statistical significance. Preserve unknown controls, normalization, repeated-unit identity and experimental uncertainty. Retain usable partial cells when an edge or second measurement is unavailable. Interpret scientific meanings and select sourced operands; deterministic functions read pixels and perform arithmetic. Do not infer partner necessity, single-component specificity, target correspondence or annotation credit from coupled bar differences alone.

Establish which molecule's measured activity depends on which partner, for which endpoint and conditions. Read the actual omission and addback arms. Check whether removal also changes nitrogen source, substrate, active subject amount, reporter or normalization. Distinguish protein addback from bypass with a chemical resource. Retain quantitative rates, detection limits and uncertainty meanings. If a controlled arm or limit is missing, report that specific gap; do not turn nondetection into zero or infer a universal required-partner set.

Identify the source-backed nonpartner condition factors relevant to the selected comparison and their reported levels before calling coverage complete. Complete coverage requires a nonempty selected factor set with known levels; do not invent factors or assume that unreported attributes match. Keep the intended partner change separate from these factors so its presence or absence is not penalized as a nonpartner difference. When condition matching is incomplete, mark coverage partial or unreported and retain the native rates with the specific unresolved comparison. Retain known selected factors under partial coverage; use unreported only when no factors are selected. An unreported selection does not establish that the publication omitted those conditions. A matched comparison is conditional on this supplied scope; it is not a global validity or purity proof.

Identify the actual measured molecular species and endpoint, and establish each added component's role from the source. A primary reaction participant or carrier differs from an enzyme that generates a reporter or coupled signal. Reporter dependence alone establishes neither physiological partner necessity nor isolated intrinsic activity of the assayed subject. Keep the studied molecule's source organism, expression host and accessory-component source distinct. Equal units or a shared paper do not establish shared molecular identity, biological origin or assay role.

Preserve the direction of each relationship: activation of one component by another does not reverse their molecular roles. Matching nonpartner conditions and normalization does not itself isolate contaminants or prove mechanism. A source's unreported condition attribute is unknown, and two displayed values do not establish distinct physical measurements. Preserve source-established physical measurement identity across contrasts: a reused reference is shared evidence, not an independent experiment. A baseline measurement reused as addback is not a separately observed restoration; a missing addback remains unknown. Preserve native values and partial comparisons when a third arm or a controlled contrast is unavailable.

Select complete numerical tokens and their native units from the source. Preserve upper limits and reported spread meanings. Identify the assayed subject, partner, endpoint and normalization separately. Use a canonical source passage for a physical measurement only when the source establishes that identity; a second mention or numerical token is not a new experiment. Leave unresolved identities unknown. Deterministic readers parse the selected spans and convert units.

Identify which activity-unit definition applies to the measured endpoint. Select its exact quantity, molecular entity and time basis, and retain the link to that endpoint. Do not borrow a unit definition from another readout or infer comparability from equal units.

Interpret the experimental meanings and nominate sourced inputs; deterministic operations read retained measurement bytes and calculate the requested numerical components. The retained-input route does not automatically parse publisher prose or infer its scientific truth. Keep conditional censoring domains separate from sampling uncertainty, SD, SEM and confidence intervals. Fractional dependence is specific to the assayed condition; chemical bypass does not establish physiological availability. Return only requested reference-evidence components, with their source bindings and limitations. Genomic partner searches, coexpression, target correspondence and annotation credit remain separate work.
